-The secret got bugged last update. It's now fixed

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

New update is out. Here's what's new:
- Removed the "Cutlery movement" anomaly option from the old house -level. Use belongings movement instead.
- Korean and Russian languages have been added to the game. You can change the language from the settings menu. The translations might not be perfect so please let me know what needs improvement.
- The secret audio recording in the game has been replaced with a better one.

Thanks for all your support! Have fun!
